notes: hvlgroup.com is the shared multi-brand storefront for Hudson Valley Lighting Group (owns Hudson Valley Lighting, Troy Lighting, Corbett Lighting, Mitzi, Schoolhouse, Sonneman, CSL). Access: direct fetch worked (HTTP 200), no robots.txt (404) so no Claude-specific disallow. This is genuine direct e-commerce (not dealer-only): product pages carry an 'addtocart-form-submit' add-to-cart form and prices, and HowToBuy states 'please purchase only through our official website and authorized retailers'. Counts sourced from the site's own in-house ASP.NET MVC catalog engine's 'total-product-count' span, cross-verified against the hidden TotalObjectCount form field and pagination math (TotalObjectCount / PageSize=60 = last page number shown) on every category fetched -- this is a first-party DB count, not a Shopify/Algolia/Searchspring estimate, so treated as exact per Rule 1. Total site catalog ('Shop All', not extracted) = 8080 products; lighting category totals sum higher than that because products are cross-listed under multiple type categories (e.g. a lantern-style chandelier appears under both Chandelier and Lantern) -- this is genuine site taxonomy, not padding. Rule 0 duplicate check: Products/Category/Downlight and Products/Category/Recessed returned the identical 17 itemcodes (verified by diffing data-itemcode sets) -- same listing under two URLs, so 'Downlight' (Architectural/CSL nav) was dropped and only 'Recessed Downlights' (Ceiling nav) kept. 'Landscape' and 'Posts & Bollards' both link to the identical Products/Category/Post?sub=Exterior URL -- one row kept. 'Trims' also links to the same Products/Category/Recessed URL as Recessed Downlights -- dropped. Rule 0 room-tree check: the site has both a Type/Application tree (Ceiling/Wall/Table&Floor/Exterior/Architectural) and a Room tree (Products/Room/Bedroom, Bathroom, Dining, Entrance, Hallway, Kitchen, Living-Room, Office). Verified empirically that the Room tree is a pure facet re-cut, not a genuine separate branch: Products/Room/Bedroom (4860 products, i.e. 60% of the entire 8080-item catalog) mixes Table Lamps/Chandeliers/Wall Sconces/Semi-Flush/Plug-in Sconces together, and its first-page itemcodes include C2140-VGL, the same SKU that is the first product on the Chandelier category page -- confirming Room pages are the same underlying product pool re-filtered by a 'suitable room' tag, not a distinct listing. Per Rule 0's 'drop only if exact same listing or pure facet re-cut' clause, all 8 Room nodes were dropped (not emitted as rows) rather than double-counted. Decor scope: Mirrors (26, e.g. Bobbin/Forma/Grant/Leo Mirror) and Decorative-Accessories (15, Clare V/Stacking decorative trays) are genuine decorative accessories, kept. Wall-Hardware (50 items: Picture Ledge, J Hook, Knurled Hook, Mollie Hook, Perkins Hook) is decorative wall hooks/racks/ledges, explicitly in scope per Rule 0's 'decorative metal hooks, racks' inclusion -- kept as 'Hooks and Shelves'. Organization-Utility (65) was title-scanned and found to be an exact mixed roll-up: its itemcode count (65) equals Wall-Hardware (50) + Decorative-Accessories (15) precisely, and its product titles are the same Picture Ledge/Tray/Hook items -- dropped per the 'mixed roll-ups: drop, don't pad' rule. Bath-Hardware (1 item, 'Oak Towel Ring') is a functional bathroom fixture, excluded under bathroom fixtures/plumbing. Pulls, Knobs (cabinet/furniture hardware), Bedding/Rugs/Throw-Pillows/Shower-Curtains (textiles), Tables/Chairs-Stools/Storage-Furniture/Beds (furniture), and Bulbs were all excluded per standing scope rules. Lamp Shades (Products/Feature/TailoredShades, 9 items, e.g. 'Gathered Wide Taper Shade') kept as a lighting accessory under Table and Floor Lamps -- it is HVLG's own shade line for its lamps, not soft-furnishing textile. Accessory-Bezel (12, 'Luxe Decorative Bezel' trim rings for recessed downlights) and Cylinders (24, cylinder pendants/flush mounts) kept as lighting fixture types under Architectural Lighting. The Sonneman 'Systems' (Suspenders, Constellation, Intervals, Purolinear 360, Ola, Tik-Tak, YO, Cubix, ALC) and 'Pivots' (Products/Family/Luxe%20Pivot) are single configurable-product/family landing pages with no total-product-count listing field (confirmed by fetch: no count span present) -- treated as product-family pages, not categories, and excluded. Feature/SurfaceMounted, Feature/WallMounted, Feature/ArchPendants, Feature/AllArchitectural and all 'All X' aggregator links (All Ceiling, All Wall, All Lamps, All Outdoor, All Architectural, All Sonneman, All CSL, All Textiles, All Decor, All Hardware, All Furniture, Shop All) were treated as Shop-All-equivalent rollups per the NEVER EXTRACT rule and not emitted. Brand pages (Products/Brand/*) excluded as brand-listing pages. No non-English category names encountered.
